slides.title: glass soap pumps
slides.detail: decant hand soap and lotion into matching pumps. way less sink clutter.

slides.title: a handheld shower head
slides.detail: screws onto your existing arm in minutes. keep the old one for move-out.

slides.title: a eucalyptus bundle
slides.detail: hang fresh eucalyptus near the shower. the steam makes it smell like a spa.

slides.title: a plant that loves steam
slides.detail: pothos or a fern by the window. they like the humidity, so they're easy.
